title: Free Community Microchipping Day
location: Layton Community House, 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP
description: Layton Community House and Longview Animal Centre (your local independent RSPCA branch) are working together to help local pet owners keep their cats and dogs safe. Saturday 17 October, 10am–3pm at Layton Community House, 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP. Microchipping is quick and simple, and gives your pet the best chance of being reunited with you if they ever go missing – it's also now a legal requirement. No appointment needed, just come along. Please bring cats in a secure carrier and keep dogs on a secure lead. Layton Community House on Facebook →

title: Pride in Place Layton: Community Party
description: The finale of Pride in Place Layton – a free community party for everyone, including families, with entertainment, activities and prizes. Sunday 11 October, 2:00pm at Layton Institute. Free to attend, but booking is required. Book your place →

title: Lightpool 2026: Welcoming Winter at the Field of Dreams
location: Field of Dreams, Bowness Ave, Blackpool, FY4 4TE
description: Artist Ivan Morison worked in the field to turn the harvested crop into a series of sculptures, coated in sand and lime – creatures that will look after the meadow over winter. This Lightpool, help welcome these field creatures to the land, with an evening of unexpected light from artists AndNow. Friday 23 October, 6:30pm-8pm at the Field of Dreams. Free. Part of "Autumn in the Field of Dreams", run by Leftcoast, supported by Arts Council England. Under 14s must be accompanied by an adult.

title: A Bublé Christmas – Starring Cameron Taylor
description: A festive tribute night at Layton Institute – swing, jazz, pop and all the Christmas favourites, performed live by Cameron Taylor with a 3-piece band. Sunday 6th December, doors 6:30pm – show starts 7:30pm. Tickets £15, available via TicketSource or on the door.

title: Garba Night at The Grange
location: The Grange, 2a Bathurst Avenue (off Dinmore Ave), Blackpool FY3 7RW
description: Fylde Coast Hindu Society brings Garba to Layton and Grange Park for the first time. An evening of dance, music, tradition and community spirit, with fun Garba for all ages, a live DJ and food stalls. Everyone welcome. Saturday 10 October, 6:30pm-10:00pm at The Grange. title: Halloween Themed Lunch Club
location: The Grange, 2a Bathurst Avenue (off Dinmore Ave), Blackpool FY3 7RW
description: A spook-tacular afternoon of good food, fun and laughter. £4 per person includes a 2-course meal, tea and coffee, bingo and a Halloween quiz. Optional fancy dress, with a prize for the best dressed guest. Everyone welcome, so bring a friend. Tuesday 27 October, 12:30pm. At The Grange.

title: Barbie Spooky Styling Session
description: A free children’s Barbie and Ken styling and play session hosted by Vintagebarbieclare. Pick your Barbie or Ken, choose their outfit and accessories, then take photos (optional) or just play. Fancy dress optional. Everything is provided and adults are welcome to join in with their children. Friday 30 October, 10:30am-12:30pm at Layton Library. Booking essential: contact Layton Library on 01253 478145 or layton.library@blackpool.gov.uk to book your child’s place.

title: Christmas Market at Christ King Church

Stalls so far include Boo Blooms, Resin by Olivia, Bling by Amy, Inner Sparkle, The Dessert Lab and more, with Mr Whippy Blackpool outside serving ice creams and waffles. Saturday 21 November 2026, 11am-3pm. Free entry.
